content.change_basis: Market move of cards currently held (from each card's add day if added in range); excludes buys/sells. change_usd sums the change_covers_holdings holdings with price history; change_pct = change_usd / start_value_usd, where start_value_usd = value_usd - change_usd (holdings without history count as unchanged). covered_change_pct is the same move relative to only the covered holdings' start value (covered_start_value_usd).
